name: @shrubbery/aviary
description: AVIARY — a player for the aigua field-recording sample library. The library is projected to `aig:` RDF and its own layout to `sux:` RDF, both served over a real TripleSource and rendered by the real interpreter (parseTriplesToConfig → planFor → renderWorkspace). The filesystem, the HTTP routes and the ONE audio element live shell-side; the browser holds no layout literal, no library fixture, and no mock.
